title: VI. Women Prisoners Occupancy Rate at national level in 2018 (as on 31st (in %) in Women Jails vis-à-vis December). Similarly, the occupancy rate Women Inmates in Other Jails of women inmates in other jails decreased during 2013-2018 from 76% in 2013 to 73.8% in 2018. The occupancy rate in women jails has decreased from 70.4% in 2013 to 58%
